items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Me and Mary Minetta, me and him was like that. And I used to gamble too... We'd gamble round there.

ctx.x: That was a common thing to pass the hat, the passage to you all the time.

Yeah, you see we had them time. We had them Norwegian ships used to come down. And them Norwegians used to come in, you know, loaded down with money, gold money. You could carry gold money at that time, gold money. They'd have ten dollar gold piece mixed up with pennies and you couldn't hardly tell the difference because it was hard to tell the difference between a ten dollar gold piece and a dime, a silver dime. It was small, you see. And many times we used to be whacking up the money after we'd get through…
What did you dress up like that for?
